artworks.title: St. Antonis Gate (St. Antonis Poort)
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront scene with buildings and a windmill in the distance, detailed in an etching style with precise linework. The monochromatic palette uses shades of gray. A wooden fence is near two figures by the water, with more figures and carts visible in the distance. The sky above has birds and clouds.

artworks.title: Heyligeweg Gate (Heyligewechs Poort)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed illustration of a cityscape. The horizon, defined by the rooftops of buildings and trees, is high in the composition. A structure with ornate gables and smoking chimneys is on the left, while a large arched gateway with similar features is on the right. In the middle, a drawbridge crosses a calm body of water with pedestrians and vehicles. The etching technique highlights intricate linework, emphasizing textures of buildings, water, and foliage for depth. The monochromatic color palette adds a vintage look. People in boats are in the water, with trees and buildings stretching into the distance.

artworks.title: Carl Larsson
artworks.description: The image displays a person's upper body, including the head, shoulders, and forearms. The person is seated, engaged in drawing. Their face is in three-fourths view, with deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard. The person's hair is closely cropped and matches the color of the beard. They wear a shirt and possibly a jacket. The person is holding a drawing tool, working on a dark, cross-hatched surface. The background is minimally detailed, focusing on the person and their actions.

artworks.title: Mr. and Mrs. Furstenburg
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of two individuals sitting closely together. The person on the right has a full beard and appears older, while the person on the left has wavy hair. Both individuals are dressed in dark clothing, and the background is heavily shaded, suggesting an indoor setting. The etching is signed in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Cavalier and Two Ladies on Horseback
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Myron A. Hofer in memory of his mother,  Mrs. Charles Hofer
artworks.description: Three individuals on horseback, captured from behind, revealing their full bodies. They are seated upright on the horses, which are depicted in motion, moving towards the background of the image. The person in the center wears a dark coat and a tall top hat, while the individuals on either side are dressed in similar dark riding attire and donned wide-brimmed hats with decorative features. Facial features are not visible due to the angle and shadowing in the image. The background shows a few indistinct figures and what appears to be a landscape under a cloudy or partly shaded sky, creating a sense of depth and motion within the setting. The illustration is done in a monochromatic, sepia-toned palette.

artworks.title: Head and Bust of a Woman
artworks.medium: charcoal with pastel on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Myron A. Hofer in memory of his mother,  Mrs. Charles Hofer
artworks.description: This image is a sketch showing the head and partial upper torso of a person facing slightly to the right while looking forward. The person's position is turned slightly, with shoulders angled and head slightly tilted. The facial features are softly rendered, with detailed focus on smooth skin and subtle shading highlighting their features. They have curly hair that is full and slightly wild, framed around the face. The person appears to be wearing a garment or shawl, drawn with soft strokes, likely to indicate loose drapery, with hints of a ribbon or bow near the neckline. There is no jewelry visible. The background is plain, composed of a rustic, textured surface that complements the sketch's color palette, emphasizing the softness of the figure drawn.

artworks.title: La morgue, Paris (The Mortuary)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 21.2 × 19 cm (8 3/8 × 7 1/2 in.)
plate (cut to platemark ): 23.3 × 20.9 cm (9 3/16 × 8 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed urban scene with densely packed buildings viewed head-on. The horizon is inferred to be high in the image where buildings meet the sky. Tall, narrow buildings form rows in the distance. Architectural details are highlighted with precise lines. Figures in period clothing are seen on a quay lined with wooden structures. The color palette consists mainly of sepia tones, giving the impression of an antique photograph or etching.

artworks.title: Study
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person standing with their body visible from behind. The person is bending forward, with arms raised as if adjusting clothing. The facial features are not detailed due to the angle of the sketch, and the hair is indicated to be under a cloth or cap. They appear to be wearing a loose garment. There is a simple outline of furniture in the background. The sketch has a quick, unfinished quality.

artworks.title: Unfinished Sketch of Lady Haden
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from the waist up. The person is depicted sitting or reclining, with a slightly angled body. The facial features are softly defined, with shadow and outline emphasized over detail. The hair is dark and covered by a hood or cap. The clothing is loosely sketched, suggesting draped fabric covering the shoulders and possibly the chest. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, with light shading lines for contrast. The sketch is monochrome, using soft pencil strokes to suggest form.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross with the Virgin and  Saint John
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.6 × 17.2 cm (10 1/2 × 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man crucified on a wooden cross, with a figure standing to the left and another figure kneeling on the right. Cherubic figures with banners are depicted in the background. The scene includes a sign on the ground and a skull.

artworks.title: The Trinity
artworks.artist: Workshop of Master of the Gerona Martyrology
artworks.description: This is a painting of a seated elderly figure with a younger figure in a large decorative initial. The elderly figure holds a wooden cross, while the younger figure embraces the cross. They sit on a throne-like platform with a richly adorned background of golden and floral patterns. Surrounding them is an ornate frame with lush green acanthus leaves and intricate designs that extend into the border of the page, indicating that this is an illuminated manuscript. This artwork is done in the style of a medieval or Renaissance manuscript illumination.

artworks.title: Saint John
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, standing in a frontal position. He has wavy, shoulder-length hair and a neutral expression with eyes gazing slightly to the side. The man is dressed in a long, flowing garment with wide sleeves, fastened at the collar with a round brooch or clasp. He wears a belt with pouches around his waist, including a box-like container. In his left hand, he holds a chalice-like cup. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with Saints Christopher and Erasmus
artworks.description: The image shows a circular artwork featuring four figures depicted in an intricate, detailed style. At the center, two seated women are shown from head to lap. Their heads are inclined toward each other, and their attire is composed of flowing robes. The woman on the left has her head covered with a veil, while the woman on the right has long, wavy hair cascading down her shoulders. Between them is a small child who appears to have a gentle expression with subtle features. The child is held by the women. To the left, a bearded man wearing a crown stands partially visible, holding a scepter and wearing a cloak. On the right, another man is seen, an ecclesiastical figure holding a book and wearing a cloak. Behind the group is a backdrop of an ornate architectural design which frames the central figures with pointed arch motifs.

artworks.title: Scribe Writing and the Author Presenting His Book
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash,  heightened with white and gold, on gray prepared paper (grisaille)
artworks.dimensions: overall (rounded top edge): 16.4 x 18.5 cm (6 7/16 x 7 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a medieval-style interior scene with several figures. One figure is seated at the center, surrounded by others who stand or kneel. The seated person wears a hat and a long robe. Another person in front of them holds a book. Other figures in long gowns and hats are around them. On the left, a person is at a desk writing or illustrating a text. The room features Gothic architecture with pointed arches, stonework, and tall, narrow windows. A small dog sits on the floor near the center group.

artworks.title: Joshua before the Lord
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a medieval manuscript page. The image shows an illuminated manuscript spread across two pages, featuring text in dark brown ink written in a formal, gothic script, with red and blue embellishments and paragraph markers. The left page contains a large, ornate initial 'I' in gold, detailed with intricate geometric patterns and spirals that extend into the margins. Below the large initial is a historiated letter, containing a small illustration of two figures in medieval attire conversing, surrounded by a golden background within the letter. The manuscript appears to be made on vellum or parchment, evident from the translucency and texture of the pages. The composition demonstrates the precision and artistry of medieval calligraphy and illumination, reflecting the labor and aesthetic sensitivity of scribes from that period.

artworks.title: Moses Counting the Children of Israel
artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornate manuscript page with illuminated text and a decorative initial. The page features a beautifully illustrated capital letter 'L' with an illuminated scene depicting five figures in medieval attire set against a gold background. They are arranged within the vertical stroke of the 'L' standing on a blue ground. Above the columns of text, the word "NUMERI" is written in multicolored, decorative letters. The surrounding text is in Latin and is rendered in a uniform, Gothic script that fills two columns on aged, cream-colored parchment. The design of the illuminated letter and the use of color within the letter contrast with the black ink of the text.

artworks.title: Meeting of Achilles and Hector
artworks.description: This is a painting of a medieval scene featuring several figures in conversation, with two figures mounted on horses. The artwork presents a group of colorfully attired individuals, some of whom are on horseback. The central figures are riding white horses richly adorned with decorative designs. The painting is set against a pastoral backdrop of blue sky and green landscape. The surrounding text and ornate floral embellishments point to its origin as an illuminated manuscript.

artworks.medium: tempera and gold leaf on vellum

artworks.title: The Nativity with Six Dominican Monks
artworks.description: Painted with royal blue, scarlet red, mint and olive green, and tones of soft brown on vellum, a woman lies next to a baby in a boxy manger as angels and monks look on in this illuminated manuscript. The woman is separated from the angels by a rocky, roof-like structure, and the monks are in a row of arches below. They all have pale skin. The woman, Mary, wears a voluminous blue robe over a vivid red dress. Her head is covered by the robe, and she has a gold halo. She reclines in a cocoon-like oval crisscrossed with medium brown lines on a lighter brown background. A baby wrapped tightly in strips of cloth lies in a gold-colored boxy manger on the far side of the woman. The woman rests one hand on the edge of his gold halo, which has a blue cross, and an ox and ass look at the child from the far side of the manger. A bearded man and two women are shown much smaller in scale to the left and right of Mary. The man has white hair, a halo, and wears a light blue robe. He sits with one leg tucked under his body in the lower right corner of this scene. He rests his head in one hand as he turns to look up at Mary over his shoulder. To the left, two women, also with halos and wearing light blue or red, pour water onto the nude baby, who is propped upright in a large urn to the left. The child holds up one hand with the first two fingers raised as blue rivulets curl down his face and body. Above, eight angels wearing robes in white, dark yellow, or light blue, and all with halos, hold their hands together facing in toward the center of the composition. Their wings are mint green lined with dark blue or red. Four green trees, two to each side, have teardrop-shaped canopies lined with seven birds to the left and eight birds to the right. Four monks stand and two monks kneel in six arches below the main scene. The monks have their hair cut into rings around their heads and wear black cloaks over white robes. All hold their hands up and look up at Mary. The background in all three registers is lapis blue painted with swirls and dots in paler blue or white. Red banners separate the angels from the rocky roof and the monks from Mary. Gold-colored, Latin text on the banners reads as follows. Top left: “GLORIA IN EXCELSIS DEO.” Top right: “ETM TERRA PAX HOIB BONE VO.” Bottom left: “ORA PRO NOBIS QVIA VIERSA NCTAES.” And bottom right: “ORA PRO NOBIX SCA DEI GENITRIX.” Traces of writing and music is visible on the other side of the sheet.

artworks.title: The Prince at the Bird-Catching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mounted archer aiming at a bird. The archer on horseback is aiming at a bird in the sky. The horse is galloping over rocky terrain, surrounded by trees, hills, and a medieval-style town in the background. The artwork emphasizes details of the horse, rider, trees, and landscape.

artworks.title: The Woman on the Hinny
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a path stretching into the distance. The horizon is in the upper third, with mountains in the background. There are small figures with animals on the path. The trees on the left are detailed, diminishing in size towards the right. The image primarily uses a black and white color palette with intricate details in the foliage and texture created by brushstrokes or etching. Rocks and plants close to the viewer are depicted with hatching and stippling, guiding the viewer's gaze along the path.
